_comment: M-Brands ONLY side-dependent ledger map for the Universal Bank Statement classifier. When a bank narration contains one of the counterparty tokens, the classifier uses the credit-side ledger for a Receipt (money in Credit) and the debit-side ledger for a Payment (money in Debit). Checked ABOVE the DB payee-directory. Each ledger is validated against the brand COA at runtime; if a ledger is not in the COA the entry is skipped and the row falls through to the normal directory/COA/LLM layers. Built from the accountant's reviewed previous output (credit-side/debit-side columns).
